message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 74.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and system developer. I want to become a Information Technology Auditor. My family can afford at most about USD 6700 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Management and system developer roles

reflection_note: The initial shortlist included PR0164, which violates the hard constraint of academic plausibility (79% required vs 74.8% achieved). This program must be dropped immediately. Both remaining programs (PR0160 and PR0020) are excellent fits for budget, location, and general career goals. PR0160 is slightly preferred because its focus on 'Technology Management' aligns more directly with the desired role of an IT Auditor/Manager than PR0020's 'Business Analytics', despite having a lower placement rate.
explanation:
Keystone Technical University
This program is recommended because its MBA Technology Management focus aligns well with your interest in management and IT Auditor roles. At an annual tuition of $2050, it fits comfortably within your maximum budget of $6700, and you meet the minimum admission requirement with your 74.8% grade. While this program offers a solid placement rate of 71%, the main trade-off is that its median starting salary ($8900) is lower than the alternative option, and it does not provide any post-study work visa benefits.

Stanmore Institute of Applied Sciences
This MBA Business Analytics program is highly recommended due to its strong focus on business information systems, which directly supports your goal in IT auditing and system development. It has the lowest tuition cost at $1450, keeping you well within budget, while also offering the highest placement rate (76%). The main trade-off here is that the curriculum emphasizes analytics over pure management theory; however, this focus results in a higher median starting salary of $10648.
